Input type date styling

  • Safari does not support the html native icon for iconpicker, despite being a -webkit- prefix. Very strange.
  • Because of this limitation in safari - no calendar icon is present at all. ex. there isn't a focusable control, good and bad.
  • Firefox does not care that you want to style the -webkit-calendar-picker-indicator they provide zero way to target this psuedo element. Firefox is the only browser that has this issue and they represent less than 2% of our user base.
  • As usual, everything works as expected in chrome.
  • we could use some selective @supports statements to allow for a fallback of a visual icon, but this isn't great either - semi-hacky approach.
  • we could also use the styling rule to simply attempt to hide the native focusable control using -webkit-calendar-picker-indicator for chrome, leaving the issue present in firefox.
